```{r preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
#library(gllvm)
#library(tidyverse)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
Xenv[1:6, ]
Xenv[, 1:3]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```

#changing method to LA
```{r running gllvm 1 l.v.}

# get true model and its predictions
true_model = gllvm(microbial[, 1:200], Xenv[, 1:2], num.lv = 1, family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")
pred_counts = predict(true_model, type = 'response', lv.pred=TRUE) 

# simulate B times and refit model
B = 10
time = rep(NA, B)
KL = rep(NA, B)
for (i in 1:B){
  sim_counts = simulate(true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
  
  time_i = system.time({
    model_i = gllvm(sim_counts, Xenv[, 1:2], num.lv = 1, family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 
#4.658s elapsed
  time[i] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts_i = predict(model_i, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
  
  KL.ij = pred_counts*(log(pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
  KL[i] = sum(KL.ij)
}

time
KL
c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
```

```{r alternating glms using 1 l.v.}

B = 10
time = rep(NA, B)
KL = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, B)

for (k in 1:B){
  sim_counts = simulate(true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
  time_i = system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # simulating 56 observations for 1 latent variable

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 4) #preset matrix of coefficients including betas and lambdas, nrow = no. of columns in the responses, no. of columns = beta0, beta1, beta2, lambda
  
  N = 20
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
      glm1 = glm.fit(y = sim_counts[, i], x = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), intercept = TRUE, family=poisson(link='log')) 
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) #1 x 4
    }
    
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4] #200 x 1
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
      glm1 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ]) #invalid type without as.numeric
      new_u[i] = glm1$coefficients 
    }
    
    u = new_u #56 x 1
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -20), 20) #clamping to limit the exp(eta)
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }}) 

  ite_converge_all[k] = j
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts_i = exp(eta)
  KL.ij = pred_counts*(log(pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
  KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
}

ite_converge_all
time
KL
c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))

```

```{r alternating glms using 2 l.v.}
  time_i = system.time({u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)) # generate 56 'observations' involving 2 latent variables
  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[1:200]), ncol = 5) #5 to account for 2 l.v and 3 betas

      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(glm2$coefficients) #1 x 5
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4:5] #200 x 2, 2 col. now
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2, 2 col. now
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
      glm2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ])
      new_u[i, ] = t(glm2$coefficients) #1 x 2
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 2, 2 col. now
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -20), 20) #clamping to limit the exp(eta)
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }})

  ite_converge_all[k] = j
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts_i = exp(eta)
  KL.ij = pred_counts2*(log(pred_counts2/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts2 - pred_counts_i) 
  KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
}
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda using 1 l.v.}
#install.packages('glmnet')

B = 10
time = rep(NA, B)
KL = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, B)

for (k in 1:B){
  sim_counts = simulate(true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
  time_i = system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # 1 latent variable

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 4)
  
  N = 20
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
      glmnet1 = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = sim_counts[, i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
      
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) #1 x 4, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 3] #200 x 1
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
      glmnet1 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ])
      new_u[i] = glmnet1$coefficients
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 1
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }})
  
  ite_converge_all[k] = j
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts_i = exp(eta)
  KL.ij = pred_counts*(log(pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
  KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
}
```

```{r alternating glms, 1 l.v. updating through constraints -- Chen}

#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]

df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
  dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))

# projection onto ball of radius c
proc = function(y, c){
  y = as.numeric(y)
  if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y)
  c * y / sqrt(sum(y^2))
}

lv_chen = function(Y, X, K, u_all, max_iter, choose_true_model){
  sim_counts = simulate(choose_true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
  n = nrow(Y)          # 56
  J = ncol(Y)          # 200
  c = 5 * sqrt(K)

  beta_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(X))
  lambda_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u_all))

  # initialize column parameters from Poisson GLMs without latent term
  for (j in 1:J) {
    fit_j = glm.fit(
      y = Y[, j],
      x = cbind(X, u_all), 
      family = poisson(link = "log")
    )
    coef_j = as.matrix(t(fit_j$coefficients))
    beta_all[j, ] = coef_j[1:ncol(X)]    
    lambda_all[j, ] = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1):(ncol(X) + ncol(u_all))]
  }

  loglik = -Inf
  
  beta_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(X)) 
  lambda_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u_all)) 
  u_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = ncol(u_all)) #56 x 1

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
  ## ---------------------------
  ## (a) ROWS FIRST: update u_i
  ## ---------------------------
    for (i in 1:n) {
      
      # current offset for row i across all columns
      
      # row-wise GLM update
      glm1 = glm.fit(
        y = sim_counts[i, ],
        x = as.matrix(lambda_all),   # J x 1
        intercept = FALSE,
        family = poisson(link = "log"),
        offset = X[i, ] %*% t(beta_all), # 1 x 200
        start = u_all[i, ],
        control = glm.control(maxit = 1)
      )
      
      u = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))

      u_proj[i, ] = proc(u, sqrt(c^2 - 1))
    }
    
    u_all = u_proj
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## (b) COLUMNS SECOND: update beta_i, lambda_i
    ## -----------------------------------------
    
    X_u = cbind(X, u_all)
    
    for (j in 1:J) {
      
      start_vec = c(beta_all[j, ], lambda_all[j, ])
      
      glm1 = tryCatch({
        glm.fit(
        y = sim_counts[, j],
        x = X_u,
        family = poisson(link = "log"),
        start = start_vec,
        control = glm.control(maxit = 1)
      )}, error = function(e) return(NULL))
      
      #if (!is.null(glm1) && all(is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
        coef_j = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))
      #} else {
        #coef_j = start_vec * 0.8
      #}
      
      beta_j = coef_j[1:ncol(X)]
      lambda_j = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1):(ncol(X) + ncol(u_all))]
      
      comb_j = c(beta_j, lambda_j) #4 x 1
      comb_proj = proc(comb_j, c)
      
      beta_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[1:ncol(X)]
      lambda_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[(ncol(X) + 1):(ncol(X) + ncol(u_all))]
    }
    
    beta_all = beta_proj
    lambda_all = lambda_proj
    
    ## ----------------
    ## likelihood check
    ## ----------------
    
    eta = X %*% t(beta_all) + u_all %*% t(lambda_all) #56 x 200
    eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -10), 10)
    mu = exp(eta)
    
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u_all, log = TRUE)) +
      sum(dpois(sim_counts, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    
    rel_change = abs(loglik_new - loglik) / (abs(loglik_new))
    if (rel_change < 1e-3) break
    
    loglik = loglik_new
  }
  return(list(Y = Y, beta_all = beta_all, lambda_all = lambda_all, u_all = u_all, mu = mu, loglik = loglik, loglik_new = loglik_new, iter = iter))
} 

ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
KL = rep(NA, ite)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_new_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_all = rep(NA, ite)

suppressWarnings(
for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({alg = lv_chen(Y = as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), X = cbind(1, scale(Xenv[, 1]), scale(Xenv[, 2])), K = 1, u_all = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), max_iter = 20, choose_true_model = true_model)
  })

  ite_converge_all[k] = alg$iter
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  
  pred_counts_i = alg$mu
  KL.ij = pred_counts*(log(pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
  KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
  
  loglik_new_all[k] = alg$loglik_new
  loglik_all[k] = alg$loglik
}
)

time
ite_converge_all
KL

loglik_new_all
loglik_all #why different?

c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
```

```{r PUT ASIDE alternating glms, 1 l.v. updating through constraints + grad. correction}
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]

df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
  dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))

ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
KL = rep(NA, ite)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_new_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_all = rep(NA, ite)

# projection onto ball of radius c
proc = function(y, c){
  if (any(is.na(y))) return(rep(0, length(y)))
  y = as.numeric(y)
  #if (any(!is.finite(y))) stop("non-finite proposal in proj_ball")
  if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y)
  c * y / sqrt(sum(y^2))
}

for (k in 1:ite){
  sim_counts = simulate(true_model2, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
  time_i = system.time({
    
    # dimensions
    Y = as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200])
    n = nrow(Y)          # 56
    J = ncol(Y)          # 200
    X = cbind(1, scale(Xenv[, 1]), scale(Xenv[, 2]))   # n x 3

    # latent dimension
    K = 2
    
    # Chen-style constraint radius
    c = 5 * sqrt(K)
    
    # initialize item parameters first (needed for row-first updates)
    beta0_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 1)
    beta_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 2)
    lambda_all = matrix(rnorm(J, 0, 1), nrow = J, ncol = K)
    
    # initialize column parameters from Poisson GLMs without latent term
    for (j in 1:J) {
      fit_j = glm.fit(
        y = Y[, j],
        x = X,
        family = poisson(link = "log")
      )
      coef_j = fit_j$coefficients
      beta0_all[j, ] = coef_j[1]
      beta_all[j, ] = coef_j[2:3]
    }
    
    # initialize u small random
    u_proj = mvrnorm(n, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = K)) #56 x 2 
    #for (i in 1:n) {
    #u[i, ] = proc(u[i, ], sqrt(c^2 - 1))
    #}
    
    max_iter = 20
    step_size = 0.001
    loglik = -Inf
    
    for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
      
      B = cbind(beta0_all, beta_all)   # 200 x 3
      
      ## ---------------------------
      ## (a) ROWS FIRST: update u_i
      ## ---------------------------
      u_all = matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = K) #56 x 2
      
      for (i in 1:n) {
        
        # current offset for row i across all columns

        # row-wise GLM update
        glm1 = tryCatch({glm.fit(
          y = sim_counts[i, ],
          x = as.matrix(lambda_all),   # J x 2
          intercept = FALSE,
          family = poisson(link = "log"),
          offset =  X[i, ] %*% t(B), # 1 x 200
          start = u_proj[i, ]
        )
        }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
        
        if (!is.null(glm1) && all(is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
          u = glm1$coefficients
        } else {
          # If it fails, keep the old u but move it toward zero (damping)
          u = u_proj[i, ] * 0.5 
        }

        u_all[i, ] = proc(u, sqrt(c^2 - 1))
      }
      
      u_proj = u_all
      u_proj = scale(u_all)
      
      ## -----------------------------------------
      ## (b) COLUMNS SECOND: update item parameters
      ## -----------------------------------------
      beta0_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 1)
      beta_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 2)
      lambda_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = K)
      
      X_u = cbind(1, scale(Xenv[, 1]), scale(Xenv[, 2]), u_proj)   # n x 4
      
      for (j in 1:J) {
        
        start_vec = c(beta0_all[j, ], beta_all[j, ], lambda_all[j, ])
        start_vec[is.na(start_vec)] <- 0
        start_vec = pmin(pmax(start_vec, -8), 8)
        
        glm1 = tryCatch({
          glm.fit(
          y = sim_counts[, j],
          x = X_u,
          family = poisson(link = "log"),
          start = start_vec
        )}, error = function(e) return(NULL))
        
        if (!is.null(glm1) && all(is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
          coef_j = glm1$coefficients
        } else {
          coef_j = start_vec * 0.8
        }
        
        beta0_j = coef_j[1]
        beta_j = coef_j[2:3]
        lambda_j = coef_j[4:5]
        
        #eta_j = X %*% c(beta0_j, beta_j) + u_proj * lambda_j
        #eta_j = pmin(pmax(eta_j, -20), 20)
        #mu_j = exp(eta_j)
        
        # gradient correction for constrained block (beta0_j, lambda_j)
        #grad_beta0_j = sum(Y[, j] - mu_j) #1 x 1 
        #grad_lambda_j = sum(u_proj * (Y[, j] - mu_j)) ########
        
        comb_j = c(beta0_j, lambda_j) #2 x 1
        
        comb_proj = proc(comb_j, c)
        
        beta0_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[1]
        beta_proj[j, ] = beta_j
        lambda_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[2:3]
      }
      
      beta0_all = beta0_proj
      beta_all = beta_proj
      lambda_all = lambda_proj
      
      ## ----------------
      ## likelihood check
      ## ----------------
      B = cbind(beta0_all, beta_all) #200 x 3 
      eta = X %*% t(B) + u_proj %*% t(lambda_all) #56 x 200
      eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -10), 10)
      mu = exp(eta)
      
      loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u_proj, log = TRUE)) +
        sum(dpois(sim_counts, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
      
      #if (is.finite(loglik_new) && is.finite(loglik)) {
      rel_change = abs(loglik_new - loglik) / (abs(loglik_new))
      if (rel_change < 1e-3) break
      #}
      
      #if (loglik_new < loglik) {
        #step_size = step_size / 2
      #}
      
      loglik = loglik_new
      
    }
  })
  
  j_all[k] = iter
  time3[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  
  pred_counts_i = mu
  KL.ij = pred_counts2*(log(pred_counts2/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts2 - pred_counts_i) 
  KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
  
  loglik_new_all[k] = loglik_new
  loglik_all[k] = loglik
}

time3
KL
j_all
loglik_new_all
loglik_all #why different?

c(mean(time3), sqrt(var(time3)))
c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 1 l.v.}
B = 10
time7 = rep(NA, B)
KL7 = rep(NA, B)
j_all5 = rep(NA, B)

for (k in 1:B){
  sim_counts = simulate(true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
  time_i = system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # 1 latent variables

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 4)
  
  N = 20
  K = 1
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
      glmnet3 = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = sim_counts[, i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(glmnet3$a0, as.numeric(glmnet3$beta))) #1 x 3, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4] #200 x 1
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
      glmnet3 = glmnet(x = cbind(lambda, rep(0, length(lambda))), y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet3$beta)[1]) #to drop the extra 0 column
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 1
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }}) 
  
  j_all5[k] = j
  time7[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts_i = exp(eta)
  KL.ij = pred_counts*(log(pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
  KL7[k] = sum(KL.ij)
}

c(mean(KL7), sqrt(var(KL7)))
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 2 l.v.}

B = 10

for (k in 1:B){
  sim_counts = simulate(true_model2, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
  sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts) 
  time_i = system.time({u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)) # 2 latent variables

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 5)
  
  N = 20
  K = 1
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
      glmnet4 = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = sim_counts[, i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(glmnet4$a0, as.numeric(glmnet4$beta))) #1 x 5, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4:5] #200 x 2
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2

      glmnet4 = glmnet(x = lambda, y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet4$beta))
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 2
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }}) 
  
  j_all6[k] = j
  time8[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts_i = exp(eta)
  KL.ij = pred_counts2*(log(pred_counts2/pred_counts_i)) - (pred_counts2 - pred_counts_i) 
  KL8[k] = sum(KL.ij)
}
```
